comparison.objective: Unscrew a flashlight cap, pour out its battery, and set the parts down safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual counterholding, threaded cap manipulation with regrasping, and controlled tipping. Thread manipulation overlaps, but there is no setting selection, relocking, or response diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Body defines five stages: body held, cap removed and safely placed, battery in box, flashlight safely replaced; no separate spec version is present.
comparison.reason: Tests complete disassembly and contents removal, whereas the candidate preserves the component and tunes a retained collar.
